title: docs(audits): archiving the 24-file 2026-06 audit series is not docs-only — 20 of the files are cited by ADRs or by @objectstack/spec's published liveness notes
body:
Filing gate: ① a measured follow-up with named locations, split out of a ruled card. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-steve` · session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** Ruling 6417413905 (letter A) on #26075 asks that `docs/audits/README.md` gain a lifecycle convention and that the closed 2026-06 series be archived. The convention is docs-only and rides #26075 PR 2. The archive is not, so it was split here rather than widening a docs PR into a published-package change.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:devx` seat. Any change to the liveness notes is a `@objectstack/spec` publish-surface edit, which the spec lane must review.

## Measured (dev report on #26075, delta J, against `main` at 17:00Z)

`docs/audits/2026-06-*.md` has 24 files.

- **6 are cited by path from ADRs** (0049, 0061, 0078, 0082, 0112). ADRs are governed and append-only, so moving those 6 leaves dead links that cannot be fixed in the ADR text.
- **14 are cited by `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` `_note` fields**, plus 3 zod comments in `packages/spec`. One is in `validation.zod.ts`, whose comment generates `content/docs/references/data/validation.mdx`. `liveness/` is in spec's `files[]`, so editing it needs an `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset and regenerated references.
- **4 have no inbound reference at all:** `ask-build-agent-development-assessment`, `datasetschema-property-liveness`, `pageschema-property-liveness` and `system-integration-property-liveness`.

## Wanted (choose in the PR, say which)

- **Minimum:** move the 4 unreferenced files under `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/`, docs-only.
- **Fuller:** also move the 14 spec-cited files, with their `_note` and zod-comment paths rewritten, a spec patch changeset and regenerated references. The 6 ADR-cited files stay in place in either case.

⛔ No ADR edit. ⛔ No file deleted; archive means move.

## Acceptance

- No live link or `_note` path points at a moved file's old location: grep the whole tree, `pnpm check:doc-authoring` and the link check.
- If spec files moved, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and the references regeneration are clean, and one patch changeset is in root `.changeset/`.

Related: #26075 (ruling 6417413905).
